description: This file declares the interface for the WebAudioPlayerModuleService and its factory within the Rialto IPC server component. It defines classes for managing WebAudioPlayer instances, handling client connections, and exposing RPC methods for WebAudioPlayer operations.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of WebAudioPlayerModuleService.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IWebAudioPlayerModuleService interface, managing WebAudioPlayer instances and client connections, and exposing RPC methods for WebAudioPlayer control.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayerModuleService instance, returning a shared pointer to the interface.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: RPC method to create a WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: RPC method to destroy a WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: RPC method to set end of stream.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: RPC method to get buffer availability.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: RPC method to get buffer delay.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: RPC method to write data to buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: RPC method to retrieve device info.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: RPC method to get current volume.
